description: This Java class implements a ScriptEventHandler that uses the javax.script API (JSR-223) to execute scripts or script functions in response to web events. It manages script context setup, handles script execution, and processes results or errors, integrating with the OFBiz framework's web and security components.

classes.name: ScriptEventHandler
classes.description: A final class that handles web events by executing scripts via the javax.script API, managing script context, and processing execution results or errors.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes a script or script function based on the provided event and request context, handling script execution, result processing, and error management.
